script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: The text does not establish that the garden-court crowd was larger than the group of military leaders.
The mixing-bowl comparison does not follow from the different goblet designs. It is unclear why trying that would produce one bowl and confused looks.
A limit of one goblet would not establish how long the feast lasted.
The text does not say that the king poured nothing himself. It says his household officials were to serve the guests.
The explanation says the two feasts were going on at the same time, but the passage does not specify when Vashti held hers.
The passage does not give the location of the king's first feast, so 'Same palace' is not established.
'Nobody had to share a table' adds a seating detail the passage does not give.
The explanation is flat and generic: after restating the command, it repeats that the crown was a specific instruction.
'Seven messengers went in' adds a movement the passage does not describe. It says the command was brought by the eunuchs.
The proposed decree bars Vashti from the king's presence, not necessarily from any future feast. The text also does not establish a next feast.
Calling the outcome Memucan's 'hope' attributes a feeling to him that the text does not state.
Honoring husbands is not the opposite of leaving households. Memucan does not address leaving in this statement.
'No second meeting' claims a detail the passage does not give.
The joke about stamping 'one language of cookies' does not make clear sense as a comparison with writing letters in different languages.
Letters being sent in each people's language does not establish that everyone could read them.
